title: PolicySet
description: Result of the policy.set JSON-RPC method (ADR-0020 §7 as amended 2026-08-16): acknowledges that the ONE global agent policy was validated and persisted. The params side carries the same effect-keyed matrix policy.get returns and is checked by the handler (content.ParseEffectPolicy — unknown keys, a tool name as a row key or a tool-kind scope are invalid params, so no configuration path can express a rule over a tool name).

ok.description: Always true on a successful set; an error response means the policy was not accepted.
